company_name: LAUDA DR. R. WOBSER GMBH & CO. KG
semiconductor_relevance: High — LAUDA specializes in precise temperature control solutions critical for various semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: LAUDA Dr. R. Wobser GmbH & Co. KG is a leading provider of temperature control equipment essential for semiconductor production and testing.
